en: Sepia-toned photographic postcard showing a high steel truss bridge crossing a river gorge with strong rapids below. The bridge has a lattice structure and is supported mid‑span by a tall, openwork metal pier set on a masonry base. Trees and rocky cliffs line the riverbanks, and a few industrial-style buildings are visible in the distance. Printed text at the top left reads "Trollhättan, Kung Oscars Bro."
